tickets.subject: Product defect - Camera won't turn on after delivery
tickets.description:
I received my order (#ORD-2024-001567) yesterday - a Canon EOS R5 camera. I was very excited to use it, but when I tried to turn it on, nothing happens. I've tried:
- Different batteries (fully charged)
- Different charging cables
- Multiple power sources
- Checking all connections

The camera appears to be completely dead. This is very disappointing as I need it for an upcoming photography assignment next week. I'd like to request a replacement as soon as possible, or if that's not possible, a full refund.

The cancellation was confirmed immediately, and I received an email saying the refund would be processed within 3-5 business days. It's now been 6 business days (January 9th) and I still haven't seen the refund appear on my credit card statement. I've checked my bank account multiple times. Please process the refund to my original payment method (ending in 4532) immediately.

tickets.subject: Can't log into my account - Password reset emails not arriving
tickets.description:
I'm having trouble accessing my account. When I try to log in, it says my password is incorrect. I've tried the 'Forgot Password' feature multiple times over the past 2 days, but I'm not receiving any password reset emails. I've checked:

- My email inbox isn't full

I need access to my account to download my order history and invoice for tax purposes. Can you help me regain access?

tickets.description: I noticed a charge of $149.99 on my credit card statement dated January 4th that I don't recognize. Can you help me identify what this charge is for? If it's an error, I'd like it reversed immediately. My account email is david.brown@example.com.

tickets.subject: Wrong item received - Ordered iPhone 15 Pro, got iPhone 15

The box was labeled correctly, but the actual phone inside is the wrong model. I need the Pro version for work (I need the better camera and processor). Can you please send me the correct item? I'm willing to return the incorrect one once I receive the right product.

tickets.subject: Subscription billing issue - Charged twice this month
tickets.description: I have a monthly subscription to your premium service, and I noticed I was charged twice in January - once on the 1st and again on the 15th. This is unusual as I've only ever been charged once per month. I checked my subscription settings and it still shows as monthly, not bi-weekly. Please refund the duplicate charge from January 15th ($29.99).

tickets.subject: Product arrived damaged - Screen cracked on laptop

The packaging appeared intact, so this might have been a manufacturing defect or damage that occurred before shipping. I took photos of the damage and the packaging. I need this laptop for my business and can't use it in this condition. Please send a replacement immediately.

tickets.subject: Need to change shipping address - Order hasn't shipped yet
tickets.description:
I placed an order (#ORD-2024-002678) yesterday, but I realized I entered my old address. I've moved since my last order. The order status shows 'processing' and hasn't shipped yet. Can you please update the shipping address to:
123 New Street, Apt 4B
San Francisco, CA 94102

My email is confirmed as alex.martinez@example.com. Thank you!

tickets.subject: Quality issue - Headphones stopped working after 2 weeks
tickets.description:
I purchased wireless headphones (order #ORD-2023-009876) about 2 weeks ago. They worked great initially, but now they won't connect to any device. I've tried:
- Resetting them multiple times
- Pairing with different devices
- Charging them fully
- Updating firmware

Nothing works. The power button responds, but they just won't pair. I'm still within the 30-day return window. Can I get a refund or replacement?

slack_messages.text: Hi team, I need urgent help with order #ORD-2024-001234. It was supposed to arrive 3 days ago but I still haven't received it. The tracking hasn't updated in 2 days. I need this for work - can someone look into this ASAP?
I can help you with that, John. Let me check the tracking details and see what's happening with your shipment. I'll update you within the next hour.

URGENT: The camera I received (order #ORD-2024-001567) won't turn on at all. I've tried everything - different batteries, cables, etc. I need this for an assignment next week. Can I get a replacement sent out today?

I'm sorry to hear about the camera issue, Jane. That's very frustrating. I've escalated this to our priority queue and we'll process a replacement order today. You should receive a confirmation email within the hour. We'll also include a prepaid return label for the defective unit.
I see a charge for $149.99 on my statement from January 4th that I don't recognize. I've checked all my recent orders and none match this amount. Can someone investigate this?
Let me look into that charge for you, David. I'll review your account history and payment records. I'll get back to you within 2 hours with details about what this charge is for.
I received the wrong iPhone model. I ordered the iPhone 15 Pro but got the regular iPhone 15 instead (order #ORD-2024-002345). The box says Pro but the phone inside is not. Help!

That's definitely a fulfillment error on our end, Emily. I apologize for the inconvenience. I've created a replacement order for the correct iPhone 15 Pro model and it will ship today with expedited shipping at no charge. You'll receive a return label for the incorrect item.

Just received my MacBook Pro (order #ORD-2024-001890) and the screen is cracked! The box looked fine so this must have been damaged before shipping. I have photos. Need a replacement ASAP for my business.

Lisa, I've initiated an express replacement for your MacBook Pro. This will ship today with next-day delivery. Please use the prepaid return label we're sending for the damaged unit. Our quality team will investigate how this occurred.
Hi, I need to change the shipping address for my order #ORD-2024-002678. I entered my old address by mistake. Can someone update it before it ships?
I can help with that, Alex! What's the correct shipping address? I'll update it right away before the order ships.
